value.description: Value as a number or numeric string. Values larger than 9,007,199,254,740,991 (JavaScript's max safe integer) will behave unpredictably.

mode.description: Can be direct, protected, or button. Direct mode requires no special action to enter into edit mode. Protected requires double click or long-press to enter edit mode. Button requires that the user click the button to enter edit mode.

align.description: Aligns the input's value right or left.

inputBounds.description: Max and min input value bounds configuration.

invalidStyle.description: Style applied to input when input value does not meet bounds.

placeholder.description: Text displayed when value is empty.

spinner.description: Provides buttons for incrementing & decrementing the value

enabled.description: The spinner will be displayed when enabled.

increment.description: The amount to increment or decrement the value when the spinner's buttons are clicked.

tooltipText.description: Mousing over this button will show a tooltip with this text, if present

enabled.description: If user should be allowed to alter the value.

containerStyle.description: Applies style to the root element of the component which contains the input and edit button. Use the style prop to apply style to the input element directly

events.name: onActionPerformed
events.description: This event is fired when the 'action' of the component occurs.
